newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Police start voting ahead of Bosnia elections.
newsitem.headline: Police start voting ahead of Bosnia elections.

text.p: Selected polling stations opened in Bosnia on Friday to allow police who will be on duty during Saturday's countrywide elections to cast their votes.

Witnesses said voting by military and other special police officers was light. At one polling station only one man, pushing a young child in a pram, had turned up to vote 90 minutes after the polling station opened at 7 a.m.
The elections are the first since the end of the 43-month-long war last November. Many Bosnian refugees have already voted at polling centres set up abroad.
